exam.title: Implementing Data Engineering Solutions Using Microsoft Fabric
exam.study_prerequisites: Hands-on data-engineering experience with loading patterns, data architecture and orchestration plus practical Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, lakehouse, warehouse, Eventhouse, Dataflow Gen2, pipelines, notebooks, security, monitoring, SQL, PySpark and KQL skills.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Implement and manage an analytics solution
Monitor and optimize an analytics solution

review.notes: Every July 21, 2026 subobjective is mapped to a configuration, identity/access layer, lifecycle mechanism, store, movement/transformation engine, grain/load contract, monitoring signal, failure boundary, optimization hypothesis, evidence or recovery decision. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 original checks cover Spark/domain/OneLake/Airflow settings; Git/database projects/deployment; workspace/item/RLS/CLS/OLS/file/masking/labels/endorsement/audit/OneLake security; Dataflow/pipeline/notebook orchestration; full/incremental/dimensional/streaming loads; lakehouse/warehouse/Eventhouse/shortcuts/mirroring; PySpark/SQL/KQL and data quality; Eventstream/Structured Streaming/windows/query acceleration; monitoring/alerts and every named error class; and lakehouse/pipeline/warehouse/Eventhouse/Eventstream/Spark/query optimization. All 27 cited URLs are cataloged: 26 reachable and the O'Reilly early-release book automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The guide records 27 hours 49 minutes of current Learn paths, four-day course, free Practice Assessment, an eight-hour O'Reilly bootcamp agenda, current commercial assessments and explicit freshness/early-release caveats.

findings.title: Reset does not clear destination data
findings.evidence: Reset changes the incremental checkpoint; append replay can duplicate existing rows. NULL watermark rows are excluded from later runs and hard deletes are not discovered.
findings.recommendation: Add key-set/count and append-reset worked example with recovery design lab.
findings.resolution: Add key-set/count and append-reset worked example with recovery design lab.

findings.title: Net CDC is not every transition
findings.evidence: Current limits include net change capture and watermark fallback when mixed CDC/non-CDC tables are selected; SCD2 remains preview.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit read-mode, history and schema evolution boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add explicit read-mode, history and schema evolution boundaries.

findings.title: Change images need a destination contract
findings.evidence: CDF starts after enablement, supplies pre/post images and deletes, and depends on retained files for replay.
findings.recommendation: Add current-state versus change-log example and checkpoint/retention exercise.
findings.resolution: Add current-state versus change-log example and checkpoint/retention exercise.

findings.title: Late-arrival adjustment changes effective event time
findings.evidence: Late arrival is evaluated before out-of-order adjustment; drop and adjust yield different window results.
findings.recommendation: Add original timestamp exercise linked to actual Eventstream SQL configuration.
findings.resolution: Add original timestamp exercise linked to actual Eventstream SQL configuration.

findings.title: Source security does not automatically follow mirrored data
findings.evidence: Fabric SQL database mirroring does not propagate source RLS, object permissions, masking or labels into OneLake.
findings.recommendation: Add source-specific destination access tests alongside OneLake engine/grant explanation.
findings.resolution: Add source-specific destination access tests alongside OneLake engine/grant explanation.

findings.title: A checkpoint is not a retained data copy
findings.evidence: VACUUM can remove obsolete data/CDF files needed by a delayed consumer; log files have a separate lifecycle.
findings.recommendation: Add dry-run, consumer-lag and time-travel retention boundaries.
findings.resolution: Add dry-run, consumer-lag and time-travel retention boundaries.

findings.title: New Spark workspace defaults are write-oriented
findings.evidence: Current V-Order guidance defaults the session setting to false for new workspaces.
findings.recommendation: Require actual setting inspection and future-write versus existing-file distinction.
findings.resolution: Require actual setting inspection and future-write versus existing-file distinction.

findings.title: Monitoring logs do not contain every diagnostic
findings.evidence: Current Data Factory workspace monitoring limitations exclude error details and diagnostics.
findings.recommendation: Keep inner-error evidence in item/activity experiences and correlate identifiers.
findings.resolution: Keep inner-error evidence in item/activity experiences and correlate identifiers.

findings.title: Scheduled notification tests require scheduled runs
findings.evidence: Schedule failures preview excludes semantic models and non-scheduled runs; main activity list has display/history limits.
findings.recommendation: Add actual-route alert test and history retention guidance.
findings.resolution: Add actual-route alert test and history retention guidance.

findings.title: Runtime GA does not guarantee all table features are portable
findings.evidence: Runtime 2.0 is GA but documented opt-in pending late-September default; Delta 4.x-specific features remain experimental and Spark-only.
findings.recommendation: Add compatibility lab and October 1 research checkpoint; do not claim rollout completed.
findings.resolution: Add compatibility lab and October 1 research checkpoint; do not claim rollout completed.

findings.title: Driver migration differs by connection route
findings.evidence: Current ADBC transition covers selected embedded-driver connectors with cloud/gateway differences and planned milestones.
findings.recommendation: Add route, type and credential comparison guidance; retain existing three research checkpoints.
findings.resolution: Add route, type and credential comparison guidance; retain existing three research checkpoints.
